title: 第13章 看来你的同伙不太给力啊第14章 出狱搜查押送雷老虎
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 喧嚣过后的丁字号，静得有些渗人。
空气里还残留着浓郁的血腥味。
陈然提着油灯，走在空荡荡的走廊里。
脚步声在走廊内极为明显。
那些平日里或是哀嚎、或是咒骂的犯人，趁着刚才的动乱，跑了个七七八八。
剩下的，要么是胆子小不敢跑的，要么是腿脚不利索跑不动的。
红莲魔女江梦璃依旧被待在原地，身上的符咒散发着微弱的金光。
陈然把油灯挂在墙上，靠着栏杆，语气调侃。
“这么好的机会，竟然没把你救出去。”
江梦璃睁开眼，那双妩媚的眸子里闪过一丝无奈。
“镇魔司既然敢把我关在这里，肯定布下了天罗地网。”
“刚才那点动静，不过是投石问路罢了。”
她看着陈然，嘴角勾起一抹嘲讽的弧度。
“那种情况下还能活下来，甚至还升了官。”
“下次他们再来，恐怕就是动真格的了。”
“到时候，我这个看守，怕是第一个就要被祭旗。”
“让他们别急着动手，或者……换个方式。”
江梦璃眯起眼，审视着眼前这个小狱卒。
竟然敢主动掺和进红莲魔教和镇魔司的博弈中。
她被困在这里，对外面的情况一无所知，如果能有个传声筒，或许能打破僵局。
她朱唇轻启，吐出一个地名。
content_en:
After the hustle and bustle, T-shaped house was so quiet that it was almost breathtaking.
The strong smell of blood still lingers in the air.
Chen Ran held an oil lamp and walked in the empty corridor.
The sound of footsteps was extremely noticeable in the corridor.
Most of the cells were empty.
Those prisoners who usually wail or curse took advantage of the commotion and ran away.
The rest were either too timid to run, or those with weak legs and feet who couldn't run.
Chen Ran walked to room No. 7.
The red lotus witch Jiang Mengli was still staying where she was, with the talisman on her body emitting a faint golden light.
"It seems that your accomplice is not very effective."
Chen Ran hung the oil lamp on the wall and leaned against the railing with a teasing tone.
"Such a great opportunity, but I didn't save you."
Jiang Mengli opened her eyes, a hint of helplessness flashed in her charming eyes.
"They're not stupid."
"Since the Demon Suppressor dares to lock me up here, he must have laid a dragnet."
"The little movement just now was just asking for directions."
She looked at Chen Ran, with a mocking arc on her lips.
"It's you, you are so lucky."
"I was able to survive in that situation and even get promoted."
Chen Ran shrugged.
"It's just good luck."
He leaned closer to the railing and lowered his voice.
"However, this kind of luck is inevitable."
"Next time they come again, I'm afraid they will be serious about it."
"When the time comes, I, the guard, may be the first to be sacrificed."
Jiang Mengli looked at him.
"What do you want to say?"
"I want to live."
Chen Ran was straightforward.
"You don't want to die here either, do you?"
"Give me a code, or a token."
"Tell them not to rush into action, or... find another way."
Jiang Mengli narrowed her eyes and examined the little jailer in front of her.
audacious in the extreme.
How dare you take the initiative to get involved in the game between the Red Lotus Demon Sect and the Demon Suppression Division.
But...
This is indeed an opportunity.
She was trapped here and knew nothing about the situation outside. If she could have a microphone, she might be able to break the deadlock.
"Aren't you afraid of death?"
"Afraid."
Chen Ran admitted frankly.
"But if you sit still and wait, you will die faster."
Jiang Mengli was silent for a moment.
"Changchun Inn."
She opened her red lips lightly and spit out a place name.
